decisions.reason: As a prominently promoted extension of a core handcrafted category, it likely met aspiration levels and fits existing craft resources well, so we would keep it.
This product is very close to the firm's established Christmas-pyramid business and its repeated home-page presence suggests satisfactory results relative to aspiration, so we would keep it.

Although the electronic music box is more distant from the traditional portfolio and therefore more uncertain, its strong promotion and the related follow-on products indicate enough acceptance to keep it for now.
The move to a second edition signals performance above aspiration for this niche complement, and in a growing market we would keep it despite its greater distance from the firm's craft core.

Because this seasonal electronic add-on was only lightly promoted and is easier to replace with newer motifs, its results likely fell short of aspiration relative to alternative uses of development capacity, so we would drop it.
Building directly on the firm's established premium pyramid line and receiving home-page emphasis, this themed variant likely performs adequately against aspiration and should be kept.
